title: Alberta voters reject plan to leave Canada
source: 来源：卫报 (The Guardian)｜粉丝团第 80 期
meta: 此文为句子级对照：上行英文，下行对应中文。

entries.en: Alberta voters overwhelmingly reject plan to leave Canada in referendum
entries.zh: 阿尔伯塔省选民在公投中以压倒性多数否决了离开加拿大的提案

entries.en: Result is a victory for prime minister Mark Carney and supporters of Canadian unity
entries.zh: 这一结果对总理马克·卡尼以及加拿大统一的支持者来说是一场胜利

entries.en: Voters in Canada's Alberta have overwhelmingly rejected a proposal to begin the process of independence, delivering a decisive victory for supporters of Canadian unity and deepening divisions within the separatist movement.
entries.zh: 加拿大阿尔伯塔省的选民以压倒性多数否决了启动独立进程的提议，为加拿大统一的支持者带来了决定性胜利，同时也加深了分裂主义运动内部的裂痕。

entries.en: With nearly 1.9m votes counted, roughly 76% people supported remaining in Canada, while 24% backed beginning a process toward separation, according to unofficial results from Elections Alberta.
entries.zh: 根据阿尔伯塔选举局的非官方结果，在已清点的近 190 万张选票中，约有 76% 的人支持留在加拿大，而 24% 的人支持启动走向独立的进程。

entries.en: The Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney, who grew up in Edmonton, Alberta's capital, celebrated the result.
entries.zh: 在阿尔伯塔省首府埃德蒙顿长大的加拿大总理马克·卡尼对这一结果表示庆祝。

entries.en: "Albertans made a clear choice. They chose unity, to build together, and to take care of each other. Above all, Albertans chose Canada."
entries.zh: "阿尔伯塔人民做出了明确的选择。他们选择了团结，选择共同建设，选择彼此关照。最重要的是，阿尔伯塔人民选择了加拿大。"

entries.en: He said the result would allow Canadians to move forward together and accelerate efforts to diversify trade, develop major infrastructure projects and make Canada a global energy powerhouse, with Alberta at its centre.
entries.zh: 他表示，这一结果将使加拿大人能够共同前进，并加快努力以推动贸易多元化、开发重大基础设施项目，使加拿大成为以阿尔伯塔为中心的全球能源强国。

entries.en: The results showed an overwhelming majority of Albertans had voted to remain and one radio show host posted: "Someone owes Albertans $130m for this theatrical waste of taxpayers' money."
entries.zh: 结果显示，绝大多数阿尔伯塔选民投了留加票，一位电台节目主持人发文称："有人欠阿尔伯塔人民 1.3 亿美元，就为这场作秀式的浪费纳税人钱财的闹剧。"

entries.en: Pollster David Coletto told the Guardian that residents felt the referendum was "a distraction away" from what they wanted their government to focus on.
entries.zh: 民意调查专家大卫·科莱托告诉《卫报》，居民们觉得这场公投"分散"了他们对政府应重点关注议题的注意力。

entries.en: "There was almost a general sadness about the wasted energy spent on this rather than the more real threats they see, including the Trump administration," he said.
entries.zh: "人们对把精力浪费在这件事上，而不是用来应对他们眼中更现实的威胁——包括特朗普政府——几乎普遍感到悲哀，"他说。

entries.en: "Most Albertans feel deep grievances with the federal government while also being proudly Canadian. The marriage may be rocky at times, and most Albertans want to see some thing changed, but very few are willing to see the marriage end."
entries.zh: "大多数阿尔伯塔人既对联邦政府心怀深深不满，又为自己身为加拿大人而自豪。这段'联姻'有时可能并不稳固，大多数阿尔伯塔人都希望看到一些改变，但很少有人愿意看到这段'联姻'走向终结。"

entries.en: The province's separatists, however, saw a silver lining.
entries.zh: 然而，该省的分裂主义者却从中看到了困境中的一线希望。

entries.en: "We don't have the final results. I think the numbers are going to fluctuate, but it is fair to say that at least a quarter of Albertans feel that Alberta needs to be treated better," said Keith Wilson, a leader of the separatist movement.
entries.zh: "我们还没有最终结果。我认为数字还会波动，但可以公平地说，至少有四分之一的阿尔伯塔人觉得阿尔伯塔应该得到更好的对待，"分裂主义运动的领导人之一基思·威尔逊说。
